Title: Ishaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ishaan - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Siya - 9 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Kavita - 40 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Kavita and Siya stand near him.]

Siya: "What lovely weather!"

[Ishaan starts crying.]

Ishaan: "What happened?"

[Ishaan smiles at Mother.]

Ishaan: "Exactly right."

[Ishaan stamps his foot in anger.]

Siya: "And then?"

Scene 2: The park - Day

Ishaan: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan does push-ups.]

Ishaan: "How beautiful!"

[Ishaan does yoga on a mat.]

Siya (excited): "Let's see."

[Siya skips rope.]

Siya (laughing): "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 3: The bedroom - Day

[Ishaan stands in the bedroom. Kavita stands near him.]

Ishaan: "Let's begin."

[Ishaan yawns loudly.]

Ishaan: "Really?"

[Ishaan stretches his arms above his head.]

Kavita (excited): "What a day to remember!"
